    2 entrances  ·  19 walk-to positions  ·  17 crypt banks (781 purchasable units over 893 crypt spaces) plus the Radiance and Serenity niche walls (122 niches)  ·  this is an illustration of the building drawn to scale in plan, so that a crypt or niche can be found before you walk in. Wall positions follow the cemetery’s own floor plan and bank depths follow the crypt type — a tandem holds two caskets end to end. Heights and the chapel furnishings are approximate, and no dimensions are implied.

    Radiance Niche Wall
    RAD-1-1-ROW-SPACE · rows K (top) to A (bottom) · Daylit alcove at the chapel’s north-west corner: it stands on the north end of bank 101-110 and looks NORTH across the alcove to the arched windows in the west exterior wall.
